report_format.name: Suricatoos PDF — Technical (EN)
report_format.summary: Suricatoos PDF vulnerability report, technical edition: the complete report, with every finding, the port and IP exposure map and the per-host appendix (English). Version 20261012g.
report_format.description: Technical edition of the premium, corporate vulnerability assessment report in PDF (English): branded cover, executive risk summary with a severity dashboard, priorities and next steps, a hexagonal PORT EXPOSURE MAP that shows every (transport, port) in the scope with its severity and the IP addresses mapped to it, a hosts and open-ports inventory, a findings summary table, detailed findings grouped by vulnerability (CVSS, CVEs, affected systems, remediation), scope, methodology and limitations, and a per-host appendix. Version 20261012g.
